placements.note: PD-30 (2026-11-15): the COMPOSITION-owned web transport row. Loads the pinned host's own fetch/search providers by public package name and provides `teamA5sfWebTransport`, the service the product row reads lazily when it builds a governed realm's confined `web` face — so the governed preset no longer needs a driver row (or a row rewrite) to have a real transport.
